facts.value: Once your enrollment deposit is paid, you can meet with your academic advisor for more information on how to register for courses.
You can find the name, email and phone number for your academic advisor in the Academic Support Team box in My ASU.
Click on the Academic Advisor option in My ASU to find this contact information and schedule your appointment.
Note that you may have a hold on your enrollment that will need to be completed before registering for classes.
Class registration typically becomes available mid-October for Spring admits.
Class registration typically becomes available mid-spring for Fall admits.
Review and complete any outstanding holds you may have under Priority Tasks in My ASU.
